purpose: Add immutable sealed simulation candidates; existing P1 records unchanged
statements:
CREATE TABLE nf_simulation_interactions (
	interaction_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	work_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	base_revision_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	closure_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_simulation_interactions PRIMARY KEY (interaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_simulation_interactions_work_id_nf_revisions FOREIGN KEY(work_id, branch_id, base_revision_id) REFERENCES nf_revisions (work_id, branch_id, world_revision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nf_simulation_interactions_work_id UNIQUE (work_id, branch_id, base_revision_id, closure_hash)
)
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_simulation_interactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()

CREATE TABLE nf_simulation_intents (
	interaction_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	actor_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	task_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	principal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_simulation_intents PRIMARY KEY (interaction_id, actor_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_simulation_intents_interaction_id_nf_simulation_i_1d48 FOREIGN KEY(interaction_id) REFERENCES nf_simulation_interactions (interaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_simulation_intents_grant_id_nf_grants FOREIGN KEY(grant_id) REFERENCES nf_grants (grant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_simulation_intents_task_id_nf_task_inputs FOREIGN KEY(task_id, generation) REFERENCES nf_task_inputs (task_id, generation)
)
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_simulation_intents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()

CREATE TABLE nf_simulation_outcomes (
	interaction_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	artifact_ref JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	selected_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_nf_simulation_outcomes PRIMARY KEY (interaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_nf_simulation_outcomes_interaction_id_nf_simulation__8f85 FOREIGN KEY(interaction_id) REFERENCES nf_simulation_interactions (interaction_id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER nf_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON nf_simulation_outcomes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nf_reject_immutable_mutation()
